Container.Name: Portico
Container.Overview: Portico media server. Store the database on a local cache pool. /mnt/user/appdata is the conventional mapping; prefer /mnt/cache/appdata/portico to avoid the FUSE pool. For Intel hardware transcoding, install the Intel GPU TOP plugin and keep the render device below. AMD uses that render device too, and codec availability is probed. For NVIDIA, use the Portico-NVIDIA template and install the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data. Prefer a local cache-pool path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/portico.

Config.Name: Transcode
Config.Description: Dedicated fast local disk directory for Disk, fallback and spill. Keep this on disk; Memory when available uses a separate bounded tmpfs (Docker /dev/shm by default).

Config.Name: Intel or AMD render device
Config.Description: The Intel or AMD render device for hardware transcoding. Remove it if this server has no GPU; actual codec availability is still probed.
